validation_dataset: Y_CORE_S1P0_VAL_r: 5 disjoint template families/class x10 trajectories =50/class; 100 events/seed; diagnostic only.
development_test_dataset: MELAUDIS_V1 / M_DEV, identical events to E1/E2-B/other E3 cells.
final_test_dataset: MELAUDIS_V1 / M_LOCK, all cells/seeds frozen before one batch; no winner selection.
class_mapping: civilian2_v1: IDMT C/car->0 and T/truck->1; MELAUDIS Car->0 and Truck->1; synthetic car->0 and truck->1. Exclude motorcycle from all core roles (class_out_of_scope_v1.1), plus bus/background/tram/bicycle/mixtures/unknown; MELAUDIS FF and 1V only.
preprocessing: CORE8_BEATS_LR1_CT: IDMT class C/T and microphone SE (sE8), require CH34; average both waveform channels; exclude ME_CH12; quarantine unexpected combinations. MELAUDIS channels averaged; synthetic mono. Native -> 8000 -> 16000 Hz resample_poly Kaiser beta=5; no external normalization/denoise/EQ. Train-only embedding StandardScaler.
segmentation: One centre 2 s crop per original event; no overlap; no short-clip padding; exclude short real clips before split freeze. E3: receiver crop centred on CPA arrival; adequate lead-in/tail; no speed-dependent zero padding.
representation: BEATs_iter3_plus_AS2M; final valid-token mean; 768D; upstream code 732d834db70ee0fc3886b4bcbcfb4ce7fb829be2
checkpoint: SHA256 d43cbfad4d7b56381c061d7a24774f908d4d94c72961f6eb1d9090ff18cd8d34; same checkpoint all core rows
classifier: Binary L2 logistic regression; C=1; LBFGS; intercept; tol=1e-6; max_iter=5000; float64; no class weights; argmax probabilities [car,truck], lowest-ID tie.
frozen_components: Entire pretrained BEATs encoder in eval mode; upstream feature normalization; simulator has no learned parameters.
trainable_components: StandardScaler fitted to own 400 training embeddings; logistic coefficients/intercepts only.
hyperparameter_selection: None. Fixed converged objective; validation diagnostic only. No target tuning/calibration/early stopping.
augmentation: Only declared S/P factors; shared environment/sensor; no extra augmentation. Reject/regenerate entire paired tuple if receiver scaling clips.
source_level: S1: S0 + rolloff offset U[-1,+1] dB/order; sinusoidal frequency fluctuation depth U[0,.02], rate U[.5,2]Hz; per-component gain U[-3,+3]dB. Exact paired settings in protocol §7.
propagation_level: P0: pinned pyroadacoustics moving direct path, Doppler and spherical spreading, Sinc interpolation; reflection=false, air absorption=false.
environment_sensor: Fixed20C/1atm/RH50%; road_material20000 upstream parameter; ideal omni sensor; no background. Speed U[30,90]km/h, range U[5,50]m, heights source.5m/mic1.2m shared across classes/cells. Source RMS.1 and receiver window RMS -26dBFS controlled.
primary_metric: Mean over 5 replicate event-level macro-F1; native test prevalence; no ensemble or balanced subsampling.
secondary_metrics: Balanced accuracy; accuracy; class precision/recall/F1; confusion; group/site recall; worst group-class recall for n>=5; Brier; 10 equal-width-bin ECE; counts/runtime.
confidence_intervals: 95% percentile paired group-and-replicate bootstrap; 10000 draws; resample whole provenance groups and replicate IDs, shared across arms. Redraw missing-class draws; >10% invalid -> inconclusive. No window bootstrap.
contrast: Four-cell mean effects deltaS/deltaP, D=deltaS-deltaP=Q10-Q01 primary; interaction I=Q11-Q10-Q01+Q00; conditional effects; E1-Q00 and E1-Q11 gaps.
hardware: Reference Apple M3 Pro CPU, >=18 GB RAM, 4 Torch/1 BLAS threads, embedding batch 8; optional >=8 GB GPU fixed across paired arms; 50 GB disk shared.
runtime_basis: Unmeasured planning range; excludes data download/admission. Local prior BEATs extraction: 785 windows/18.99 s; rendering timing unknown. Original planning range retained conservatively for reduced binary budget; not measured.
expected_artifacts: Resolved YAML; hashes/versions/commit/dependency lock; manifests/class map/group audit; scaler/head; cache index; event predictions; metrics/per-class/per-group/confusion; bootstrap/CI; timing/hardware/access log; artifact index. Paired source/geometry/parameter manifests; source/render hashes; no-fallback logs; rejection/technical checks; four-cell contrast/interaction report.
falsification_criterion: Across four cells: upper95%(D)<=0 falsifies directional dominance; upper95%(D)<.03 falsifies practical >=.03 claim only. Upper95%(deltaS)<=0 rejects beneficial source enrichment. Crossing thresholds inconclusive; sign-reversing conditional effects forbid stable ranking.
target_leakage_control: M_DEV evaluation only, never model selection. M_LOCK inaccessible until all arms/seeds/configs hashed; one final batch, no refit or winner selection afterward.
data_readiness: File-level audio hashes, eligible class counts, independent groups and immutable split manifests pending. Stop if DATASET_PROTOCOL support floors fail. New Y_CORE not generated; backend commit642f95ea83417b662906712c5902d7b7dd665092 and dry-source adapter require future technical validation. v1.1 SE_CH34 car/truck inventory: 3902/511 events in 6 site/date groups. Retained split gives 4/1/1 groups, failing >=2 validation/test floors; no split assigned or floors relaxed. Motorcycle excluded from every core role.
